notes.title: Patch Update - Control Compatibility
notes.content:
Patch update for Perished World Merchant EX:

-Full compatibility with control was added.

PS/Xbox Controller:
D-Pad/Left Analog - Move Character
X/A - Interact/Confirm
O/B - Cancel
SQUARE/X: Run
TRIANGLE/Y: Equip Weapon
R1/RB: Change Weapon
R2/RT: Attack
START/OPTIONS: Menu
L3/LS: Crouch
